mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGES ( message_id, session_id, sender_type, content, route, intents_json, selected_policy_id, candidates_json, evidence_json, resources_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{sessionId}, #{senderType}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{route, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{intentsJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{selectedPolicyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{candidatesJson, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{evidenceJson, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{resourcesJson, jdbcType=CLOB}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, session_id, sender_type, content, route, intents_json, selected_policy_id, candidates_json, evidence_json, resources_json, created_at FROM CHAT_MESSAGES WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
